privacy_entity.label: Privacy mode switch
privacy_entity.description: The camera's Privacy switch (tapo_control creates it as switch.<camera>_privacy). While it is on, the lens is closed and the image sensor and IR LEDs are off.

night_vision_entity.label: Night vision switching select
night_vision_entity.description: The camera's Night Vision Switching select (tapo_control creates it as select.<camera>_night_vision_switching, options auto/on/off). Forced on or off is honoured; on auto the sun is used as the proxy for IR. Assumes the Night Vision mode select is set to Infrared: in Full Color, or when Smart mode lights the spotlight, the spotlight replaces the IR LEDs and draws a different amount depending on its intensity, which this profile does not model.

fixed_config.power: {% set nv = states('[[night_vision_entity]]') %}{% if is_state('[[privacy_entity]]', 'on') %}2.1{% elif nv == 'on' %}3.2{% elif nv == 'off' %}2.3{% else %}{{ 3.2 if is_state('sun.sun', 'below_horizon') else 2.3 }}{% endif %}

measure_description: Measured manually with a Shelly Plus Plug UK, polling its Switch.GetStatus apower every 2 s and averaging, with the camera on its own USB adapter (the adapter's draw is included). Privacy mode on: 2.1 W; watching by day (night vision forced off, colour image): 2.3 W; watching at night (night vision forced on, IR LEDs lit, black-and-white image): 3.2 W. 60-90 s per state after settling, repeated privacy readings agreed within 0.05 W. tapo_control has no day/night sensor, so the Night Vision Switching select decides: forced on uses the IR figure, forced off the day figure, and on auto the sun is the proxy for IR. Firmware 1.9.3 Build 260521. Covers the Infrared night-vision mode only. Spotlight, measured at night on the same unit (camera base about 2.3 W): Infrared 3.21 W; Full Color at spotlight intensity 1 / 3 / 5 = 2.52 / 3.03 / 3.90 W. tapo_control's number entity advertises 1-50, but this camera only accepts 1-5 (higher values fail with setWhitelampConfig -40101). light.<camera>_floodlight_timed follows the spotlight: in Smart mode a walk-past lit it for about 50 s (the plug showed IR giving way to the spotlight), and the entity went on and back off with HA's ~30 s polling delay. Switching into Smart or Full Color mode also lights it for one timer period (5 min).
